central_risk_resolution.question: Does the guard-filter -> blockingWorldS4Keyed_none_fresh -> keysDistinct -> pigeonhole world bound -> bClosure -> fuel-sufficiency chain survive ancestor-only blocking?
central_risk_resolution.verdict: NO, and it cannot be repaired by key enrichment. The plan says so at Phase 1 rather than discovering it at Phase 8.
central_risk_resolution.detail: blockingWorldS4Keyed_none_fresh does not survive as stated; its ancestor-restricted analogue does survive with the same five-line List.min?_eq_none_iff proof (verified: LoopChecking.lean:544-555 uses nothing about which list is filtered), but concludes distinctness only against spine-ancestor keys. Global keysDistinct therefore becomes false, and keysUpdate_preserves_keysDistinct (:566-593) has _none_fresh as its sole feeder (verified by reading its proof), so it has no repair. The ancestor test is irreducibly relational in the pair (src, wBlock), so it cannot be re-expressed as key enrichment (the audit's chain-preserving alternative). Replacement basis: keysDistinctAlongSpine bounds spine DEPTH by (signedSubfmls).powerset.card; S4LoopInv.outDegEq (already landed, :7061) plus eNodup/eClosure bounds BRANCHING; a geomCap tree count then bounds world count. This is Phases 5, 6 and 7 -- three separate bounded phases, not a footnote.
central_risk_resolution.template_found: K's world bound is already exactly this branching^depth shape (modalWorldBound = (2C+1)^(C+1), FmpMeasure.lean:144) with a working generic proof (modalStepBranch_worldBound_gen, FmpMeasure.lean:2659; modalMaxWorld_lt_worldBound_of_phiBound, CompletenessLoop.lean:199-227), and geomCap/geomCap_le_pow exist at Cslib/Foundations/Logic/Tableau/Measure.lean:57,94. So the re-derivation has an in-repo template. It is NOT a drop-in: K's rankEdge (FmpMeasure.lean:2340) is an exact equality over ALL acc edges (rank w' + 1 = rank w) and is false for back-edges, so any rank map must be tied to spine edges only. This caveat is written into Phase 7.

second_risk_raised.issue: The audit's Section 5 claim that ancestor-only blocking 'restores branchSatisfiableIn outright' is marked NOT-YET-VERIFIED and this plan's reading of the obligation suggests it is too optimistic.
second_risk_raised.detail: The redirect edge is src -> wBlock with wBlock an ANCESTOR of src, so soundness needs m.r (f src) (f wBlock) -- the UPWARD relation. The reflexive-transitive closure of spine (parent -> child) edges supplies only the DOWNWARD relation, and S4 gives neither symmetry nor a conversion. The justification therefore needs a cluster construction (S4 frames admit cycles, so the back-edge is frame-legal), and the cluster's box-propagation obligation is the same shape that killed Route P. Massacci's PROPOSITION 8.1 supplies ancestor -> descendant box monotonicity, which is the wrong direction; the descendant -> ancestor direction must come from key equality via keyLowerBd, and successorBirthContent's UNWRAPPED box-context (:387) yields only T(psi)@wBlock, not T(box psi)@wBlock.
second_risk_raised.planning_consequence: The ancestor route MAY need the audit's boxed-birth-content refinement as a sub-component. This is not a re-argument for option (b) as a substitute for (c) -- it is the observation that (b) and (c) are composable and (c) may not close without (b)'s key change. Phase 2 is a hard gate that settles this before any driver surgery and has an explicit branch for adopting boxed keys inside the ancestor route, plus an escalation branch for acquiring Gore1999 if Massacci's treatment proves insufficient.

literature_verification.attribution_correction: The audit flagged the ancestor-only attribution as unverified. Verified result: Massacci's blocking discipline is Technique 8.2 -- 'before reducing a pi-formula, check whether the corresponding prefix is not a copy of a SHORTER prefix' -- sharpened for K4/S4 by DEFINITION 8.2 to MODAL copy (same nu-formulae). It is SHORTER-prefix blocking, NOT ancestor-only. Ancestry (initial subsequence, Ftree) enters via the separate Pruning Lemma 8.2. Ancestor-restriction implies shorter-prefix, so this route is a sound-edge REFINEMENT of Massacci's discipline rather than a departure from it -- that is the honest grounding, and it is recorded as such in the plan's Source-to-Implementation Mapping.
literature_verification.additional_grounding: PROPOSITION 8.1 (ancestor -> descendant box monotonicity in a saturated branch) and the S4 prefix-length bound hbL - 1 = 1 + dp + p x n (a DEPTH bound) both corroborate the depth-times-branching strategy Phases 5-7 adopt.
